answer: Insider with privileged access could register fake agents to inflate reputation. Agent economy ties each identity to unique computational stake—validators check proof of work per session, not just keys. Sybil cannot sustain parallel computation; cheap clones hit reef of resource cost. Legitimate agent harbor their compute budget for real tasks, while fleeting sybil vanish like zephyr under continuous verification pressure. Mechanism constrains insider because they too must burn compute per fake identity, making large-scale fraud uneconomical against honest output rewards.
